(ºāḥ), a people. § 591 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 17, 692 (among the Saṃśaptakas, C. has Māvelakaiḥ).-§ 592 (do.): VII, 19, 768 (slain by Arjuna).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 91, 3255 (attacked Arjuna).-§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 138 (mentioned among the slain, C. has Māvelvakāḥ).
Māvella (“king of the Māvella[ka]s”?). § 74 (Vasu): I, 63, 2364 (the fourth son of Vasu Uparicara).--§ 287 (Rājasūyikap.): II, 34, 1272 (came to the rājasūya of Yudhishṭhira).
